title: Framework Dependency Review is unavailable without Dependency Graph access
title_de: Framework-Dependency-Review ist ohne Dependency-Graph-Zugriff nicht verfügbar
summary: Exact Framework Draft PR #27 head 66d90872cfc0125536267d574b776d2e88d26b23 has a correctly pinned, least-privilege Dependency Review job, but GitHub rejected the exact-head run because Dependency Review is unsupported for this repository. The prior associated Dependency Graph SBOM endpoint readback returned HTTP 404. This is a GitHub configuration/access blocker, not a defect that may be hidden or weakened in the Framework workflow.
summary_de: Der exakte Head 66d90872cfc0125536267d574b776d2e88d26b23 des Framework-Draft-PRs #27 hat einen korrekt gepinnten Dependency-Review-Job mit minimalen Berechtigungen, aber GitHub lehnte den Exact-Head-Run ab, weil Dependency Review für dieses Repository nicht unterstützt wird. Der vorherige zugehörige Dependency-Graph-SBOM-Endpunkt-Readback lieferte HTTP 404. Dies ist ein GitHub-Konfigurations-/Zugriffsblocker und kein Defekt, der im Framework-Workflow verborgen oder abgeschwächt werden darf.
observed_behavior: GitHub Actions run 29647958872 on exact PR #27 head 66d90872cfc0125536267d574b776d2e88d26b23 reported: Dependency review is not supported on this repository. Please ensure that Dependency graph is enabled. The earlier read-only request to repos/Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-test-Framework/dependency-graph/sbom returned HTTP 404 Not Found. All other task-owned security checks for the exact current PR head passed or were trigger-skipped as designed.
observed_behavior_de: GitHub-Actions-Run 29647958872 auf dem exakten PR-#27-Head 66d90872cfc0125536267d574b776d2e88d26b23 meldete: Dependency review is not supported on this repository. Please ensure that Dependency graph is enabled. Die frühere nur lesende Anfrage an repos/Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-test-Framework/dependency-graph/sbom lieferte HTTP 404 Not Found. Alle anderen task-eigenen Security-Checks für den exakten aktuellen PR-Head bestanden oder waren wie vorgesehen trigger-skipped.
expected_behavior: The Framework repository provides the Dependency Graph capability needed by GitHub Dependency Review, and the exact PR #27 head rerun succeeds without suppressing the job, changing its fail policy, broadening permissions, or bypassing review controls.
expected_behavior_de: Das Framework-Repository stellt die von GitHub Dependency Review benötigte Dependency-Graph-Fähigkeit bereit, und ein Rerun des exakten PR-#27-Heads ist erfolgreich, ohne den Job zu unterdrücken, seine Fail-Policy zu ändern, Berechtigungen zu erweitern oder Review-Controls zu umgehen.
impact: The Draft PR cannot reach verified_pr while a required security/dependency check fails. Dependency and license changes can therefore lack the repository-native GitHub review intended by the workflow until the external configuration/access condition is resolved.
impact_de: Der Draft-PR kann verified_pr nicht erreichen, solange ein erforderlicher Security-/Dependency-Check fehlschlägt. Dependency- und Lizenzänderungen können daher die vom Workflow vorgesehene repository-native GitHub-Review vermissen, bis die externe Konfigurations-/Zugriffsbedingung behoben ist.
preconditions: Framework Draft PR #27 remains open at exact head 66d90872cfc0125536267d574b776d2e88d26b23.
GitHub Actions and the Dependency Graph API remain reachable for the repository.
A repository owner or administrator can make the required GitHub configuration decision.

evidence.command: rtk proxy gh run view 29645450452 --repo Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-test-Framework --log-failed; rtk proxy gh api -i repos/Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-test-Framework/dependency-graph/sbom

root_cause: GitHub Dependency Review reported that the required repository capability is unsupported. The observed SBOM HTTP 404 establishes that the Dependency Graph endpoint is unavailable at the current access/configuration state; it does not by itself distinguish a disabled feature from another GitHub-side entitlement or visibility condition.
root_cause_de: GitHub Dependency Review meldete, dass die erforderliche Repository-Fähigkeit nicht unterstützt wird. Das beobachtete SBOM-HTTP-404 belegt, dass der Dependency-Graph-Endpunkt im aktuellen Zugriffs-/Konfigurationszustand nicht verfügbar ist; es unterscheidet allein nicht zwischen einer deaktivierten Funktion und einer anderen GitHub-seitigen Berechtigungs- oder Sichtbarkeitsbedingung.
proposed_remediation: An authorized repository owner or administrator must enable or otherwise make Dependency Graph available, verify the setting/readback, and rerun Dependency Review on the unchanged exact PR #27 head. Do not disable, make advisory, skip, or otherwise weaken the workflow as a substitute.
proposed_remediation_de: Ein autorisierter Repository-Owner oder Administrator muss Dependency Graph aktivieren oder anderweitig verfügbar machen, die Einstellung bzw. den Readback verifizieren und Dependency Review auf dem unveränderten exakten PR-#27-Head erneut ausführen. Der Workflow darf nicht als Ersatz deaktiviert, advisory geschaltet, übersprungen oder anderweitig abgeschwächt werden.
acceptance_criteria: An authorized GitHub configuration readback proves that the Dependency Graph capability is available for Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-test-Framework.
Dependency Review completes successfully for exact PR #27 head 66d90872cfc0125536267d574b776d2e88d26b23 or a later explicitly verified task-owned head.
The immutable action pin, dependency/license policies, least permissions, and fail-closed enforcement remain unchanged.
validation_plan: Read the repository configuration/capability with authorized GitHub API evidence without changing workflow code.
Rerun or observe the exact-head Dependency Review job after the configuration change.
Recheck PR #27 local/remote/PR-head equality, all current checks, SonarQube Cloud, reviews, and review threads before any verified_pr claim.
regression_tests: GitHub Actions Dependency Review check run reaches completed/success on the exact current PR head.
legitimate_control_tests: A benign dependency manifest change is evaluated by the existing pinned Dependency Review action without extra workflow permissions or a token bypass.

current_github_reconciliation_20260726.disposition: The historical capability blocker no longer exists; a later explicitly verified pull-request head succeeded under the current fail-closed workflow.

residual_risk: Reopen this archived record if GitHub disables Dependency Graph, if the current pinned fail-closed workflow regresses, or if a later relevant Dependency Review execution again fails for the same capability reason.
residual_risk_de: Diesen archivierten Record wieder öffnen, falls GitHub Dependency Graph deaktiviert, der aktuelle gepinnte fail-closed Workflow regressiert oder eine spätere relevante Dependency-Review-Ausführung erneut aus demselben Capability-Grund fehlschlägt.

history.detail: Exact Framework Draft PR #27 head 5b2a26a41e7621e7b246aa1a060149252cfe3062 failed GitHub Actions run 29645450452 because Dependency Review is unsupported; the read-only Dependency Graph SBOM endpoint returned HTTP 404. This record is blocked pending an authorized GitHub configuration/access disposition and is not a workflow-code remediation authorization.

Exact Draft PR #27 head 66d90872cfc0125536267d574b776d2e88d26b23 again failed Dependency Review run 29647958872 with the same unsupported-repository/enable-Dependency-Graph message. All task-owned security gates otherwise passed; status remains blocked pending authorized GitHub configuration or access resolution.

The Framework Dependency Graph SBOM endpoint now returns HTTP 200 with an SPDX-2.3 document. Later Framework PR #42 head dc6cf411e78b3f37f1e4be52edef59894560b1ae completed Dependency Review run 29978759046/job 89116042141 successfully. Current source retains the immutable action pin, contents-read permission, high/runtime-development failure policy, and warn-only false. The historic PR #27 failure remains retained; the external capability blocker is closed and archive eligible.
